qualification.details: Qualification: Absorption / deputation: Officers holding analogous posts or feeder post with experience as mentioned in the Recruitment Rules in a Major Port Trust; Feeder post: Executive Engineer (Civil) in the scale Rs.10750-16750 with 4 years regular service in the grade, failing which 2 years regular service in the grade and a combined regular service of 9 years in the scales Rs.10750-16750 and Rs.9100-15100 in Civil Engg. Dept.; Direct recruitment (Recruitment Rules): Degree or equivalent in Civil Engg. from a recognized University / Institution Experience: Direct recruitment (Recruitment Rules): Nine years experience in executive cadre in Planning / Construction / Design / Maintenance preferably of Port and Marine Structures in an Industrial / Commercial / Govt. Undertaking Age limit: Maximum 40 years (as on last date of receipt of applications) | Other conditions: | Open only to eligible Officers of Major Port Authorities (Except KPL) Application must come through proper channel from the parent Port Authority No Objection Certificate of the respective Port Authority to relieve the candidate is required Vigilance / Administrative Clearance in the proforma at Annexure-2 is required | Desirable: | Experience preferably of Port and Marine Structures (as printed for direct recruitment in the Recruitment Rules)

how_to_apply: Apply through the Online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways (http://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in).
Send a print-out of the online application through proper channel.
Enclose copies of educational qualifications and experience and an undertaking not to withdraw, if selected.
Affix a self attested passport size photo on the application.
The parent Port forwards the application with ACRs / APARs, NOC, vigilance clearance and service details to the Secretary, Chennai Port Authority, to reach by 31.12.2026.
important_instructions: The crucial date for determining eligibility is the last date of receipt of applications, 31.12.2026 Veracity of University Certificates and recognition of the Degree may be ensured and certified by the Port The Circular with Annexures is also available on www.chennaiport.gov.in

content_sections.heading: ChPA Superintending Engineer (Civil) Recruitment 2026 - Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.chennai_port_authority_chpa_tamil_nadu: Civil Engineering Department, Chennai Port Authority, Chennai
Officers of Major Port Authorities holding analogous posts, or the feeder post of Executive Engineer (Civil) with the experience set out in the Recruitment Rules (Annexure-1)
Maximum 40 years (as on last date of receipt of applications)

content_sections.heading: ChPA Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. RC1/0299/2026/GA gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download ChPA notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Absorption / deputation: Officers holding analogous posts or feeder post with experience as mentioned in the Recruitment Rules in a Major Port Trust; Feeder post: Executive Engineer (Civil) in the scale Rs.10750-16750 with 4 years regular service in the grade, failing which 2 years regular service in the grade and a combined regular service of 9 years in the scales Rs.10750-16750 and Rs.9100-15100 in Civil Engg. Dept.; Direct recruitment (Recruitment Rules): Degree or equivalent in Civil Engg. from a recognized University / Institution Experience: Direct recruitment (Recruitment Rules): Nine years experience in executive cadre in Planning / Construction / Design / Maintenance preferably of Port and Marine Structures in an Industrial / Commercial / Govt. Undertaking Age limit: Maximum 40 years (as on last date of receipt of applications) Other conditions: Open only to eligible Officers of Major Port Authorities (Except KPL) Application must come through proper channel from the parent Port Authority No Objection Certificate of the respective Port Authority to relieve the candidate is required Vigilance / Administrative Clearance in the proforma at Annexure-2 is required Desirable: Experience preferably of Port and Marine Structures (as printed for direct recruitment in the Recruitment Rules)

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for ChPA Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications received after the last date, without ACRs / APARs or without enclosures will not be considered Applications not received through proper channel will not be considered

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointment on absorption / deputation basis, governed by terms and conditions prescribed by the Central Government Period of probation: 2 years (Recruitment Rules)

rows.event: Last date for receipt of applications forwarded by Port Authorities (also crucial date for eligibility)

content_sections.heading: How Will ChPA Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Selection on absorption / deputation method from eligible Officers of Major Port Authorities.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Copies of educational qualifications and experience Undertaking not to withdraw, if selected (Annexure-5) Self attested passport size photo affixed on the application Photocopy of ACRs / APARs for the last 5 years, attested on each page by an officer not below Deputy Head of Department Willingness to join, No Objection Certificate, and Vigilance / Administrative Clearance (Annexure-2) Complete service details in the format at Annexure-4; details of any penalty in the last 10 years

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ChPA Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply through the Online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways (http://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in). Send a print-out of the online application through proper channel. Enclose copies of educational qualifications and experience and an undertaking not to withdraw, if selected. Affix a self attested passport size photo on the application. The parent Port forwards the application with ACRs / APARs, NOC, vigilance clearance and service details to the Secretary, Chennai Port Authority, to reach by 31.12.2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: The crucial date for determining eligibility is the last date of receipt of applications, 31.12.2026 Veracity of University Certificates and recognition of the Degree may be ensured and certified by the Port The Circular with Annexures is also available on www.chennaiport.gov.in
